Outcome_variable.evidence_source: One major determinant of life satisfaction is how the individual responds to major life events (Heller, Watson, & Ilies, 2004; Lucas, 2007; Suh, Diener, & Fujita, 1996). One of the major life events that can have a long-lasting effect on life satisfaction is marriage (Lucas, 2007; Stutzer & Frey, 2006). People who are married report higher levels of happiness and well-being compared to those who are single or divorced (Diener, Gohm, Suh, & Oishi, 2000). This positive effect of marriage on well-being may only be temporary, as life satisfaction shows an eventual decline back to baseline after marriage (Lucas & Clark, 2006).
